description: Fetch the logged-in viewer's personal event schedule (booked sessions and meetings). Use get_agenda for the full public agenda and my_meetings for meeting requests by status. The PDF agenda URL is omitted unless include_pdf_link is true.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

include_pdf_link.description: true adds the downloadable PDF agenda URL.

name: my_schedule
title: Get my B2match schedule
